explanation.summary: NORSK SATELLITTELEFON AS (991 442 561), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2007-05-29; address Industrivegen 26, 3895 EDLAND, Norge. Main industry is 47.400 Detaljhandel med informasjons- og kommunikasjonsteknologiutstyr; 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Mari Øien; Board chair: Mari Øien. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 4.34 m, operating profit NOK 107.27 k, net profit NOK 114.47 k, equity NOK 543.26 k, total assets NOK 1.62 m. Website https://www.satellittelefon.no is verified: the org number appears on the page.
